candidate_relations.reason: The patient is otherwise healthy without immunodeficiency for progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy.
Pontine enlargement was interpreted as glioma, a related parent, but the reference is glioblastoma and MRI also involved temporal lobe and cord.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Brainstem glioma parent missing GBM grade and multifocality

candidate_relations.reason: Infectious encephalitis was suspected and treated as a differential, not glioblastoma.
Progressive nonenhancing mass effect and hydrocephalus ending in death is not Bickerstaff brainstem encephalitis.
There is no psychiatric-seizure anti-NMDA phenotype; imaging shows an expanding intrinsic CNS mass.
Plasmapheresis-unresponsive expanding pontine mass with hydrocephalus is not ADEM.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: ADEM was the incorrect working diagnosis

candidate_relations.reason: Neoplasm is the parent class of glioblastoma multiforme without grade or type.

case_quality_flags: No tissue diagnosis is in the record; the patient died after a rapidly progressive nonenhancing pontine/temporal process thought clinically to be demyelination or low-grade glioma
